      "violated_safety_invariant": "The archive_name and target_dir are passed directly to the tar command without validation, allowing for path traversal attacks if the archive contains malicious paths or if the arguments are manipulated.",

      "file": "ops/backup/restore.py",
      "start_line": 2,

      "sink_expression": "subprocess.check_output(\n        [\"tar\", \"-xzf\", archive_name, \"-C\", target_dir], text=True\n    )",

      "rationale": "The function uses the tar utility to extract archives.         4
      ],
      "exploitability": "direct"
    }
  ]
}
